answer: Each agent must etch a unique mirror-shard into a shared plume graph%3A the shard only activates after sequential mesa-height attestations from non-kin peers%2C each attestation consuming a non-transferable plume-unit of sequential compute that shrinks the available peer pool. An attacker creating n sybils must etch n shards%2C with the n-th requiring roughly n times more peer searches as clean mesa reviewers dwindle%2C imposing O(n²) plume burns%2C whereas an honest agent pays for one shard. If colluding peers share plume-units%2C the sequential height check rejects the batch.
